caption:
One blogger dictated 182,718 words into this app across 36 different programs \u2014 and never manually rewrote a single one.

Wispr Flow started as voice dictation, but the part making reviewers stop mid-sentence is Command Mode: highlight what you just said, tell it \"make this more concise\" or \"make this sound more formal,\" and it rewrites itself. No keyboard. No highlight-and-retype. You're talking to your draft like it takes notes for a living.

Underneath that is AI Auto-Edits \u2014 stripping filler words, fixing punctuation, formatting lists while you're still talking, in Slack, email, ChatGPT, Claude, docs, wherever you type. And it's grown past dictation entirely: Notetaker, now on Mac, sits in your meetings and hands you the notes afterward. You never open a notebook.

It's not flawless everywhere. Windows users have flagged occasional freezing in apps like VS Code, and Flow re-adding itself to startup after being disabled \u2014 Mac is currently the smoother ride. But the volume of independent, hands-on coverage this thing has picked up in the last couple months suggests it's doing something real.

If you've ever wished you could just say the edit instead of making it, this is worth five minutes of curiosity.

Full breakdown \u2014 link in bio.

slides.heading: Say The Edit Out Loud
slides.body: No keyboard. No highlighting. You talk, and the words rewrite themselves in front of you.

slides.heading: The Type-Then-Fix Loop We All Do
slides.body: Draft the email, then go back: cut the run-ons, delete every \"um,\" fix the punctuation, reformat the list. Every email, every Slack message, every single time.

slides.heading: Editing Becomes A Conversation
slides.body: Highlight what you just said, tell it \"make this more concise\" or \"sound more formal,\" and it rewrites in place \u2014 like dictating notes to someone who actually listens.

slides.heading: It Cleans Up Before You Notice
slides.body: Filler words vanish, punctuation fixes itself, lists format mid-sentence \u2014 in Slack, email, ChatGPT, docs, anywhere you'd normally type.

slides.heading: Meetings Turn Into Notes On Their Own
slides.body: Notetaker sits in your Mac meetings and hands you the notes afterward. You never open a notebook or type a word.

slides.heading: The Rough Edge
slides.body: Windows users report occasional freezing in apps like VS Code, and Flow re-adding itself to startup after being turned off. Mac is the smoother experience right now.
